TZA.note: States nothing on AI harms rules.
The AI is in health care, not general administration.

facts.fact: A Muhimbili University researcher says Tanzania already uses AI through the Ministry of Health to support TB diagnosis from chest X-ray images.

Muhimbili University researchers built a chest X-ray AI for TB in people with HIV, trained on about 3,000 patient images from public facilities, reporting 92% accuracy, and it is now in trials ahead of TMDA approval.
